defaultMode.label: Where stock and orders come from
defaultMode.help: Our ERP, another ERP, or no ERP. A store that has its own choice on the stock page keeps it. With an ERP but no keys yet, the shop practises against a pretend ERP and its stock stays as it is.

requestTimeoutSeconds.label: Wait for the ERP (seconds)
requestTimeoutSeconds.help: How long one call to the ERP may take before it counts as failed.

maxAttempts.label: Tries per ERP call
maxAttempts.help: When the ERP is busy or does not answer, try again up to this many times in total. A wrong key is never tried again.

backoffBaseMs.label: First pause before trying again (milliseconds)
backoffBaseMs.help: Each further pause is twice as long, up to the longest pause below.

backoffMaxMs.label: Longest pause before trying again (milliseconds)
backoffMaxMs.help: Also the most the shop waits when the ERP asks it to come back later.

backoffJitter.label: Spread the pauses a little
backoffJitter.help: Waits a random part of each pause, so many tries do not all hit the ERP at the same moment.

pageSize.label: Rows per page from the ERP
pageSize.help: How many stock rows the shop asks for in one call.

maxPagesPerRun.label: Most pages in one stock pull
maxPagesPerRun.help: A safety stop. The next pull carries on where this one stopped.

stockPollMinutes.label: Check the ERP's stock every (minutes)
stockPollMinutes.help: The shop asks for stock that changed since the last check, so a missed message from the ERP never leaves stock wrong.

updatedSinceOverlapSeconds.label: Read back a little further (seconds)
updatedSinceOverlapSeconds.help: Each check also reads this much before the last one, in case the two clocks differ. Rows read twice change nothing.

maxAgeSeconds.label: Oldest message accepted from the ERP (seconds)
maxAgeSeconds.help: A signed message older than this is refused, so an old one cannot be sent again.

stockEnabled.label: Use the pretend ERP's stock
stockEnabled.help: Only for tests and demos. Off: while there are no ERP keys, the shop's stock is never touched.

timeoutSeconds.label: Live stock check at checkout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: The last check before an order asks the ERP once and waits this long. No answer: the shop uses its own copy of the stock, so checkout never waits.

defaults.label: Locations every new warehouse gets
defaults.help: Code, kind and name of each. The damaged bin is one of them.

requireDamagedBin.label: Every warehouse keeps a damaged bin
requireDamagedBin.help: The last damaged bin of a warehouse cannot be archived. Damaged stock is never sold.

sellableLocationKinds.label: Sell from these kinds of location
sellableLocationKinds.help: Stock in these locations counts as available on the shop. The damaged bin never counts.

stockLocationCode.label: Location that receives the ERP's stock
stockLocationCode.help: In each warehouse linked to an ERP warehouse, the ERP's stock numbers go into the location with this code.
